If you run a med spa, you’ve probably had **ten different agencies promise you “more leads” just this month.**

That’s actually **not** what I’m here to pitch you.

At **The Luxora Collective**, we work specifically with **U.S. med spas doing between $500K and $3M a year**, and we start every relationship the exact same way… with a **Revenue Leak Audit and Market Blueprint.**

In about **45 minutes**, we look at your real market, walk through your numbers from **lead to membership**, and identify the **3 to 5 biggest revenue leaks** in your current system.

Because most of the time, the issue isn’t getting more leads.  
It’s that **revenue is slipping through the cracks inside the system you already have.**

And here’s my promise to you.  
If I can’t find **at least three real improvements worth serious money**, I’ll tell you that honestly… and you still keep the Blueprint. No pressure.

So if you’ve been watching our content, clicking around, and you’re still a little on the fence, this is the perfect next step.

Just tap **Learn More**, fill out the short application, and if it looks like a good fit you’ll see my calendar to book your session. ✨

If your med spa is doing anywhere between **$50K and $3M a year** but you still feel **cash-poor or like growth is harder than it should be**, you probably don’t actually have a lead problem.

You likely have a **revenue leak problem.**

This is what I see over and over again when I look inside clinics:

You generate **200 leads.**  
Maybe **50 actually book.**  
About **30 show up.**  
Around **12 move forward with a treatment plan.**  
And maybe **2 ever become long-term membership patients.**

So the marketing isn’t the real issue.  
The **revenue is leaking** between lead → booking → consult → treatment plan → membership.
